message: はんなり舞踊

name: Misasagi
message: 「Why so formal? What brings you to me?」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, you see, regarding the upcoming Holy Night Festival, I'm currently asking around for everyone's opinions.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「It's already that season, isn't it? Only a few more months until graduation. How bittersweet.」

name: Synn
message: 「Since it's the final Holy Night Festival for the third-years, I want you all to make some fun memories.」

name: Ria
message: 「It's a special occasion, after all♪」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Let's see~~ Nothing comes to mind right away.」

name: Synn
message: 「Anything at all is fine! If there's something you think would be fun~, please let me know.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Fun, fun...」

name: Misasagi
message: 「I... want to dance.」

name: Synn
message: 「You want to perform as a maiko?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「It's not a spectacle to put on show. I mean everyone dancing together and having fun.」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh!! Come to think of it, we did that last year too!」

name: Misasagi
message: 「You mean the campfire dance, right? To 'Jingle Bells' of all songs, for some reason.」

name: Ria
message: 「W-Well, that's because~~」

name: Misasagi
message: 「We aren't children anymore. When it comes to dancing, sophisticated ballroom dancing is the obvious choice, wouldn't you say?」

name: Synn
message: 「I-Is that how it works--」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Stepping in time to a moody melody, hands touching the one you love. I want to enjoy an elegant moment like that...」

name: Synn
message: 「Dancing with the one you love...」

name: Ria
message: 「Akane-chan... you have someone you like? Hey, tell me who~~」

name: Misasagi
message: 「I couldn't possibly say it right in front of the person.」

name: Ria
message: 「Huuuuh--!?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「However, if you insist that much, I suppose I have no choice.」

name: Synn
message: 「N-No way...\s03」

name: Ria
message: 「N-No way... Akane-chan likes Synn-kun... Wh-Wh-Wh-Wh-What do I do\s01」

name: Misasagi
message: 「As for me...」

name: Misasagi
message: 「I only have eyes for Rii-a\s04」

name: Synn
message: 「Wha!?」

name: Ria
message: 「H-Heyyy!! Akane-chaaan!! Teasing me with jokes like that is a big no-no!」

name: Misasagi
message: 「I'm not lyin'. I want to dance with Rii-a.」

name: Ria
message: 「J-Jeez! Synn-kun is watching, so you can't make jokes like that, bad girl!」

name: Misasagi
message: 「I'm tellin' you, it's no joke. You've stayed by my side all three years, after all. For our final Holy Night Festival, I want to dance with Rii-a.」

name: Ria
message: 「Akane-chan...」

name: Misasagi
message: 「I want to make one last memory with Rii-a.」

name: Ria
message: 「Jeez... It's not like we're saying goodbye forever...」

name: Synn
message: 「Wh-What a beautiful friendship! We must definitely incorporate a moody dance.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「I'll be countin' on you to make it nice♪」

name: Synn
message: 「Though, I've... never danced before. I'll have to learn how to dance.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Then you've got nothin' to worry about. A genuine high-society young lady will take the lead for you, won't she?」

name: Ria
message: 「Huh?」

name: Synn
message: 「That's right! We have Ria-senpai... As a daughter of the Kujou family, dancing must be second nature to her. Then everything will be fine!」

name: Ria
message: 「H-Hold on~~」

name: Synn
message: 「Ria-senpai. I humbly request your instruction.」

name: Ria
message: 「Huh... Huuuh~~!?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「There's no way she can't dance, right~」

name: Ria
message: 「I... I can dance! Something like dancing is a total piece of cake!」

name: Synn
message: 「That's our Ria-senpai! I'm counting on you!」

name: Ria
message: 「Y-Yeah, you bet!」
